_comment: Template: DCAT/CGMES manifest of a set of model files.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Fill in the paths. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar manifest --config this-file.json
_when_to_use: Use before handing a model set to a toolchain that expects a manifest.ttl next to the models folder.
_input_note: Use 'dir' for every .xml, .rdf and .ttl file in one folder, OR 'files' for a list. Not both.
_note_accessUrl: Folder written in front of each file name in dcat:accessURL. A relative path such as 'Instance/Grid/cimxml' is used as it is; empty takes the last folder name of 'dir'.
_note_output: Where to write the manifest. Empty: manifest.ttl in the parent of the models folder.
